HOW TO PLAY

↑/W accelerate · ↓/S brake · ←→/A D steer · Esc pause
Touch: use the on-screen buttons.

Every glowing gate is a RIFT: the timezone, sky and physics change — Slipstream (fast & slippery), Time Dilation (rivals & ghost slow), Void Drift (extreme drift), Time Surge (rivals & ghost speed up), Mirror (the world flips).

Finish a lap and your best lap returns as a cyan ghost. Drive through it for a SYNC BOOST.
